note: Facts for /coverage/ that the index files cannot show. Each one is a claim with a source. A claim marked confirmed:false is never printed. Mandatory claims must be confirmed or the build stops. Edit by hand when a fact changes, then run docs/release/build-coverage-page.js.

weekly-start.source: Collection of the weekly UK snapshots began on 27 Sep 2026 (2026-W39), as /press/ and /shelf-price-index/vs-cpi/ state; this is when collection began, not where supply starts (see supply-floor)

daily-basket-start.source: https://data.yappman.com/methodology/: daily basket history from 24 Sep 2026; the Kaggle metadata records no run on 25 Sep 2026

snapshot-rows.source: https://data.yappman.com/shelf-price-index/method/: over 75,000 products a week, 75,835 in the week 43 snapshot of 25 October 2026

morrisons-from-w44.source: Apify dataset metadata only, checked 12 Nov 2026: the first Morrisons weekly snapshot is snapshot-morrisons-2026-W44 (see morrisons-w44-w45)

w41-three-retailers.source: https://data.yappman.com/notices/w41-skipped/ and /licences/: week 41 has no complete data for Tesco, Sainsbury's and Asda

actor-history-sentence.source: UK Actor README of build 0.2.44 (latest from 17 Nov 2026 14:04 UTC): "How far back. Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda and Aldi, from ISO week 42 of 2026 (the snapshot of 18 October 2026). Earlier weeks are not returned." The reason clause on this site (run records no longer exist) is ours, not the README's

supply-floor.source: Publisher's decision of 17 Nov 2026: weekly files and the Actor's price history are supplied from 2026-W42 for Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda and Aldi; a check of our run records on 17 Nov 2026 showed weeks 42 to 46 read direct for those four shops; the records for weeks 39 to 41 no longer exist. UK Actor build 0.2.44 enforces the floor.

aldi-w41.source: Apify dataset metadata only (name, item count, created date; no items read), checked 12 Nov 2026: snapshot-aldi-2026-W41, 3,759 items, created 2026-10-11T03:00:26Z

morrisons-no-price-history.source: UK session code evidence, 12 Nov 2026: the Actor's price-history mode returns an empty priceHistory for every Morrisons row and never charges for it (src/history/__init__.py line 26, HISTORY_RETAILERS = tesco, sainsburys, asda, aldi; src/history/enrich.py line 48)
